citation: Plummer KE, Bearhop S, Leech DI, Chamberlain DE, Blount JD (2018) Effects of winter food provisioning on the phenotypes of breeding blue tits. Ecology and Evolution 8:5059–5068. CC BY.
what_one_row_is: One row per breeding adult blue tit sampled in 2008–2010: site, nest box, pair, winter feeding treatment, sex, age class, reproductive effort, size, feather and plasma biochemistry, and brood outcomes.
